decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship and has repeatedly won the German Bread Institute's gold medal, showing it builds directly on the firm's mastered confectionery know-how and can be judged and improved through external quality testing.

The dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 trimming of the other new breads and draws on established rye expertise, but with no reported results it remains the most exposed to further range cuts.
The marzipan stollen sits beside the award-winning stollen line, uses the same recipes, handcraft and seasonal gift channels, so the firm can readily interpret and sustain its performance.
